snippet.title: Denshattack! - Deep Dive with the Developers
snippet.description:
Go behind the scenes with Undercoders, the team creating Denshattack!

This deep dive combines gameplay with developer interviews to explore the inspirations behind the game, its trick-and-grind gameplay system, and the bizarre bosses that stand in your way.

👇 WISHLIST NOW & JOIN THE MOVEMENT 👇
